description_en: Retrieves the result of an identification request
kebab_example: aliyun dytnsapi get-identification-result --session-id example --auth-code example --api-version 2023-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetIdentificationResult

parameters.description_en:
The authorization code.

> In the [Phone Number Verification Service console](https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply), you can obtain the authorization code, which is the same as the authorization ID on the **My Applications** page.
